senses.gloss: (v. דּוּץ II) to prick, squeeze, fix, stick.—Part. pass. דָּעִיץ fixed.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 2:21">Targ. Y. Ex. II, 21</cite>.
Targ. O. Gen. XXX, 38 ed. Berl. (some ed. ודַ׳; Bxt. ודְעִיץ Pe.).—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 74a:5">B. Bath. 74ᵃ</cite> <he>דַּעֲצִיתֵה וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>אנחיתיה</he>, Ar. <he>דַּצְיֵיה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note). I stuck it on the point of the lance.
